title: [E12-13] Configurable Activity Threshold and Rest State Machine
body:
<!-- nasj-backlog:E12-13 -->

**Parent epic:** https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/13

**User Story:**
As a wearable participant, I want a configurable qualifying-activity threshold with rest/reset rules, so reminders match a testable definition.

**Epic:** E12 — Optional wearable safety, firmware & privacy  
**Domain:** IoT firmware / Local companion / Privacy  
**Type:** Feature  
**Priority:** P1  
**Target Release:** B — Competition prototype — 10 December 2026  
**Estimated Hours:** TBD — team estimate required  
**Story Points:** 5 — provisional source estimate  
**Sprint / Day:** Unscheduled  
**Assignee:** Unassigned  
**Owner Role:** Firmware/Privacy  
**Status:** Proposed  
**Source PDF Mapping:** US-031  
**Suggested Labels:** `story`, `P1`, `release:B`, `epic:E12`, `iot-firmware`, `local-companion`, `privacy`

**Dependencies:** [E12-11](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/162)
**Dependency Provenance:** Source blockers: E12-11; additional proposed blockers: None.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Initial 40-minute threshold labeled unvalidated and editable; sustained activity, rest reset, cooldown and inactivity behave deterministically.
- [ ] Start with an editable 40-minute threshold explicitly labeled unvalidated.
- [ ] Define qualifying activity, sustained accumulation, rest-reset duration, cooldown and inactivity rules.
- [ ] Use a monotonic local timer and prevent missing sensor data from accumulating qualifying activity.
- [ ] Persist only permitted settings and make reset/dismiss deterministic.

**Technical Notes / Deliverables:**

Implement states such as IDLE/ACTIVE/REST/COOLDOWN with documented transitions; accelerated test clocks must not imply 40 real minutes elapsed.

**Verification / Evidence:**

Replay exact-boundary, interrupted activity, rest reset, disconnect and cooldown traces; compare expected and actual transition/reminder times.

**Completion Rule:** Attach evidence for all criteria and complete review. Verify applicable permissions, failure states and business invariants. Label synthetic results; individual wearable data never enters commerce.

**Release Boundary:** Use isolated synthetic commercial records and distinguish simulation, observed evidence and physical hardware. This story does not authorize real contracts or live money movement.
